Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick update from our side: procurement has pushed the budget approval window out by ~6–8 weeks due to the Q3 forecasting cycle. That means we need to re-forecast the target close and reprioritize milestones. Specific asks: 

- Can you update the MAP with a new target close in the early September timeframe (we're aiming for 2026-09-01 but would accept +/- 2 weeks)
- Put more emphasis on security/compliance and procurement steps first; we need to get SOC 2 evidence and legal templates ready before we run the integration pilot
- Please reduce the initial pilot scope so we can validate quickly without procurement blocking the whole deal

Looping in Priya (procurement) — Priya, can you confirm the budget timeline and the best contact on your side for contract redlines?

Thanks — I think the MAP you sent will work fine as a starting point if you can shift the dates and reprioritize.

—Jamie
VP, Digital Platforms
NovaHealth

- New target close: 2026-09-15 (gives a buffer for legal/procurement)
- Reprioritized milestones:
  * Phase 1 (now priority): Security & compliance evidence transfer (owner: NovaHealth), Legal redlines complete (owner: NovaHealth + NovaHealth legal) — target 2026-05-28
  * Phase 2: Technical discovery & reduced-scope PoC (owner: Redwood + NovaHealth) — target 2026-06-30
  * Phase 3: Pilot integration (limited scope) — target 2026-08-15
  * Phase 4: Procurement sign-off & contract execution — target 2026-09-15
- Dependencies: SOC 2 report, sample dataset for PoC, procurement standard terms

Action: Jamie / Priya — confirm procurement window and whether 2026-09-15 is acceptable. If you prefer the earlier 2026-09-01 we can tighten pilot dates.
